title: wslua: Generate definition files for Lua Language Server
description:
This makes the "Documentation" CI job generate wslua defintion files compatible with https://luals.github.io/. This helps developers work on Wireshark Lua plugins, by adding autocompletion and embedding the doc directly inside compatible text editors.

In order to automatically include the definition files with a standard distribution of LuaLS, they should be committed in a repo configured as a submodule of https://github.com/LuaLS/LLS-Addons. Are you interested in creating a repository inside the Wireshark group for this purpose?

Otherwise they can be manually included, or I can take care of creating a repo elsewhere.

The AsciiDoctor files generated by `tools/make-wsluarm.py` are not modified by its refactoring.

AI-Assisted: no
